Aphelios.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Jhin has low armor, so build armor first. If Aphelios’s healing is preventing you from finishing him off, get resistances, then fit Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Aphelios.combo: Root Aphelios with Jhin W Deadly Flourish after he steps on Jhin E Captive Audience or after you mark him with a basic attack. Follow with a basic attack and hit him with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. If he retreats while injured, finish him with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position. Jhin W Deadly Flourish will not root him if you use it before he is marked.
Aphelios.escape: When Aphelios can slow you with Gravitum and root you with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites, don’t engage; keep your distance. Engage during windows when he can’t use that root, especially when he isn’t holding Severum and has a weapon with low burst damage, and follow up with Jhin W Deadly Flourish to root him.
Aphelios.fight: Check the next weapon in Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and trade during weapon windows with low burst damage. Set up Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill minions in succession before bouncing to Aphelios, then follow with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. Keep your distance first when Aphelios has a way to catch you.
Aphelios.laning: Early on, threaten Aphelios with Jhin P Whisper’s loaded final shot while farming safely. Back off after firing it, and farm with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade while reloading. Keep one Jhin E Captive Audience for escape and place the rest in the brush and river to block gank paths.
Aphelios.teamfight: Jhin should use his range from the very back and follow an ally’s immobilizing effect immediately with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Use Jhin E Captive Audience to block approach paths in advance, and spread out from allies so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn’t hit you all. Use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position to target Aphelios as he retreats after losing health.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios slows you with a Gravitum basic attack, Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites can follow with a root, so immediately move out of range. Also back off when marked by a Calibrum attack to avoid follow-up damage and preserve your health. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil triggers one extra attack from his main weapon on each champion hit, so spread out from allies when he can use it.

Ashe.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Jhin has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Ashe.combo: If Ashe steps on Jhin E Captive Audience or is hit by an ally’s attack, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Follow with a basic attack and use Jhin P Whisper’s final shot on Ashe. If she retreats while injured, finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position. Jhin W Deadly Flourish won’t root her if you use it before she is marked.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no ability to create distance on her own, so engage when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has worn off. Confirm that Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is down too to reduce the risk of being stunned. Close the distance, then slow and mark her with Jhin E Captive Audience and root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish.
Ashe.fight: Trade briefly just after Ashe W Volley is down. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, then look for an angle to reach her after it wears off. Use Jhin P Whisper’s final shot on Ashe, and back off to reload, using Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and Jhin E Captive Audience to cover the gap.
Ashe.laning: Early on, threaten with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot loaded while farming safely. Set up the caster minions’ health, then calculate your position and target so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade kills them in succession and bounces to Ashe last. After firing your final shot, move out of Ashe’s basic attack range and finish reloading.
Ashe.phase: Early on, Jhin should focus on surviving safely while dodging Ashe’s poke rather than trying to build up damage. The available information doesn’t establish who has the advantage late, so Jhin should keep targeting Ashe from a safe position.
Ashe.teamfight: Jhin should use his range from the back line and place Jhin E Captive Audience in advance on Ashe’s approach paths. After an ally’s attack or a trap marks Ashe, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Use Jhin R Curtain Call when an injured Ashe retreats. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow can interrupt Jhin’s ultimate, so fire from a safe position where you won’t be stunned.
Ashe.watch: Dodge Ashe W Volley’s slowing cone by moving sideways. Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow is refreshed with each basic attack, so don’t stay within her basic attack range for long. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow flies in a straight line and stuns, so change direction to dodge it; while her ultimate is available, don’t start a small fight from out of vision.

Caitlyn.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to survive. Caitlyn’s damage is mostly physical, and Jhin has relatively low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
Caitlyn.combo: Follow up with Jhin W Deadly Flourish to root her, then attack and use Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. If Caitlyn retreats while injured, finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid paths with Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap. Mark her with a Jhin basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, then hit her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish to root her.
Caitlyn.fight: Look for a trade just after Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to clear the wave. Set up minion health, then angle Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to hit Caitlyn on its final bounce and follow with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. After firing the final shot, back off and reload, using abilities to cover the gap.
Caitlyn.laning: While Caitlyn is strong early, don’t force a kill and give one away; farm under your turret if needed. Keep Jhin P Whisper’s final shot loaded to threaten her, then move out of Caitlyn’s range to reload after firing. Keep one Jhin E Captive Audience in reserve and use the extra traps to watch the brush and river gank paths.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong in the early laning phase, so farm safely and survive. Once you have more items, look for chances to finish off low-health opponents with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and Jhin P Whisper’s final shot.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Jhin should use his range from the back line. After an ally’s attack marks an enemy or Jhin E Captive Audience hits them, root them with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Use Jhin E Captive Audience to block approach paths in advance, and avoid passages where Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap may be placed. Use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position to target injured opponents as they retreat.
Caitlyn.watch: When Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to poke, stand behind allied minions so they take the hit first. If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you are rooted and then take heavy damage from Caitlyn P Headshot, whose range is increased. Avoid traps in brush and narrow passages.

Draven.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Draven’s main damage is physical, and Jhin has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Also keep enough health to stay out of Draven R Whirling Death’s execute range.
Draven.combo: Place Jhin E Captive Audience where Draven’s axe will land to slow him and set up the condition for Jhin W Deadly Flourish to root him. If the trap hits, root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish, follow with basic attacks, and use your final shot on Draven. If he retreats while injured, finish him with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe distance.
Draven.escape: Look to engage after Draven uses Draven E Stand Aside, when he has only one Draven Q Spinning Axe or has lost them all. Draven has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in and hit him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish while he is marked to keep him there.
Draven.fight: Don’t trade while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes; trade when he has only one or has lost them all. Place Jhin E Captive Audience where an axe will land, or fire Jhin W Deadly Flourish after marking him, to make it harder for him to catch the axe. After he drops an axe, close the distance and use your final shot on him.
Draven.laning: Early on, farm safely while threatening with Jhin P Whisper’s loaded final shot. If a trade is difficult, don’t force it; farm and let Draven step forward, then look for a play there with your allied jungler. After firing your final shot, move out of the opponent’s range and use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and other abilities to cover the reload.
Draven.phase: Early on, survive without giving Draven a kill, since his basic attacks with two axes are powerful. In the mid game, trade in short bursts with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and your final shot, and use Jhin R Curtain Call to join fights outside the lane. In the late game, use Jhin’s burst with more items to target squishy opponents, and keep looking with your team for chances to catch Draven alone after he has earned an early gold lead and grown stronger.
Draven.teamfight: Jhin should fight behind his allied frontline and slow Draven with Jhin E Captive Audience where Draven Q Spinning Axe will land, making him drop the axe. Immediately after an ally’s immobilizing effect or Jhin E Captive Audience catches Draven, hit him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. If an injured Draven retreats, start Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position where Draven E Stand Aside can’t interrupt you with its forced displacement.
Draven.watch: Avoid trading early while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Draven can use Draven W Blood Rush to gain movement and attack speed and close in, so block his path to where an axe will land with the slow from Jhin E Captive Audience or the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Watch out for the forced displacement from Draven E Stand Aside, and after avoiding the first hit of Draven R Whirling Death, get out of its return path too.

Ezreal.build: First consider movement speed to help close the distance. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so if you build resistances, consider both armor and magic resistance.
Ezreal.combo: Set up the caster minions’ health so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade kills them in succession and bounces to Ezreal, then follow with Jhin’s final shot. If Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, mark him with Jhin E Captive Audience or a basic attack and root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Finish him with Jhin R Curtain Call as he retreats while injured.
Ezreal.escape: The moment after Ezreal uses Ezreal E Arcane Shift is your chance to engage. Slow him and apply a mark with Jhin E Captive Audience, then root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Avoid Ezreal Q Mystic Shot while engaging, since each hit makes his escape ability come back sooner.
Ezreal.fight: Keep minions between you and Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and trade briefly. Make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift, then close the distance and move to avoid Ezreal Q Mystic Shot so the escape ability doesn’t come back quickly.
Ezreal.laning: Move within the wave and use minions to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. Wait for a chance to use Jhin’s final shot on Ezreal, then back off after firing and use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and other abilities to cover the reload.
Ezreal.phase: Early on, Jhin is easy to poke in open areas, so survive safely behind minions. In the mid game, use Jhin R Curtain Call to join fights outside the lane, and once you have more items, look for chances to finish off low-armor Ezreal with Dancing Grenade and your final shot. The available information doesn’t establish who has a definite advantage late.
Ezreal.teamfight: Jhin should fight behind his allied frontline and wait for Ezreal E Arcane Shift to be used. After an ally’s immobilizing effect or Jhin E Captive Audience sets up the condition, use Jhin W Deadly Flourish, then open Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position on an injured Ezreal as he retreats. When retreating at low health, avoid lining up with an ally so Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage can’t hit you both.
Ezreal.watch: Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot from behind minions. If Ezreal W Essence Flux has marked you, briefly move out of range before the bonus damage detonates. When low on health, move back along terrain and out of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage’s straight path.

Jinx.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Jinx’s main damage is physical, and Jhin has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Jinx.combo: Set up caster minion health with basic attacks so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade kills them in succession and bounces to Jinx last. Follow with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot on her. After Jhin E Captive Audience or an ally’s attack marks Jinx, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. If she retreats while injured, finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position.
Jinx.escape: Jinx has no ability to create distance on her own, so engage when Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has already been used. If Jinx W Zap!’s slow misses too, slow her with Jhin E Captive Audience, then root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish once she is marked. Avoid chasing just after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.fight: Trade briefly and hard when Jinx pokes with rockets, since she has no minigun attack speed stacks then. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! has missed or is already used and you’ve dodged the slow from Jinx W Zap!, close the distance with the slow from Jhin E Captive Audience and root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish so she can’t get away. Jhin is weak while reloading, so back off after using your final shot.
Jinx.laning: Choose a position that doesn’t overlap with minions so Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rocket basic attacks don’t hit you along with them. Pressure her with Jhin P Whisper’s loaded final shot, then use it on Jinx. While reloading, move out of the opponent’s range and farm with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and other abilities. Keep one Jhin E Captive Audience in reserve and place the extra traps in the brush and river to watch gank paths.
Jinx.phase: Early on, Jhin is weak while reloading, so survive safely while pressuring with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. Late game, Jhin should still focus on burst damage rather than sustained damage, and avoid fights just after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.teamfight: Jhin should use his range from the back line and place Jhin E Captive Audience in advance on Jinx’s approach paths. Immediately after an ally’s attack or a trap marks Jinx and an immobilizing effect lands, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. If she retreats while injured, start Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position, and don’t start a new fight just after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets also damage units around the minion, so don’t stand next to a minion while Jinx is farming. Avoid the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers! and the slow from Jinx W Zap!, and look for an opportunity when either misses or has been used. Don’t stay within range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! while missing health, and don’t start a fight right after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.

Kaisa.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first against Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, so if you lack the burst to finish her at once, also build magic resistance and health.
Kaisa.combo: Set up caster minion health with basic attacks, then use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill them in succession and bounce the final hit to Kai’Sa, followed by Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. If Kai’Sa steps on Jhin E Captive Audience or an ally’s attack marks her, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish and follow with basic attacks. If she retreats while injured, finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position.
Kaisa.escape: At this point, mark Kai’Sa with a basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, then hit her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish to root her. If Kai’Sa W Void Seeker has hit you and its mark remains, don’t engage; retreat toward your allies.
Kaisa.fight: Mark Kai’Sa with a basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, then root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. When she is injured, hit her with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot.
Kaisa.laning: Early on, push the lane to pressure Kai’Sa’s CS and health. Set up your position and minion health so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade kills minions in succession before bouncing to Kai’Sa. After firing your final shot, back off and finish reloading while farming with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and other abilities.
Kaisa.phase: From the mid game onward, target injured Kai’Sa with the burst from Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and your final shot, and the long range of Jhin R Curtain Call. In the late game, watch out for Kai’Sa’s sustained attacks and engage; work with your allies to root and finish her in one burst while she is squishy.
Kaisa.teamfight: Place Jhin E Captive Audience on side approach routes, and have Jhin use his range from the back line. If Kai’Sa dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish before her shield wears off and finish her with your allies. Immediately after an ally’s immobilizing effect lands, use Jhin W Deadly Flourish and Jhin R Curtain Call. If Kai’Sa retreats while injured, target her with Jhin R Curtain Call.
Kaisa.watch: Right after being hit by Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, she can dash in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, so fall back toward your allies until the mark disappears. When Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain is expected, stand near allied minions to spread out the missiles. If stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin have built up, wait out of range for them to expire, and secure vision on the flank to prepare for the stealth from evolved Kai'Sa E Supercharge.

Kalista.build: Kalista's main damage is physical, and Jhin has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor to withstand the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Kalista.combo: Make Kalista step on a Jhin E Captive Audience trap or mark her with an ally's attack, then root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Follow up with basic attacks and Jhin P Whisper's final shot; if Kalista retreats while injured, finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position. Jhin W Deadly Flourish won't root her if you use it before she is marked.
Kalista.escape: Kalista P Martial Poise's leap requires her to start a basic attack, so limit her approach from outside her range and catch her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish as soon as she is marked.
Kalista.fight: Kalista P Martial Poise's leap depends on basic attacks, so manage your distance from outside her range and look for a chance to hit Jhin W Deadly Flourish when she starts an attack. In short trades, bounce Jhin Q Dancing Grenade off minions you kill in succession so it hits Kalista, then land Jhin P Whisper's final shot. Don't let a fight drag on while spears are stacked in you.
Kalista.laning: Early on, farm safely while keeping the threat of using Jhin P Whisper's final shot on a champion. After firing it, back off to reload and farm with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade in the meantime. Breaking Kalista's vision can cause her incoming basic attacks to miss, so retreat into brush or behind a wall when in danger.
Kalista.phase: Early on, Jhin is vulnerable while reloading, while Kalista pressures him with basic attacks and spear stacks, so play safely and take short trades. The available information isn't enough to judge which champion has the advantage late game.
Kalista.teamfight: Jhin should use his range from the backline and land Jhin W Deadly Flourish immediately after an ally applies immobilizing crowd control. If Kalista looks ready to throw her support with Kalista R Fate's Call, spread out and block her approach with Jhin E Captive Audience. Use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position when an injured opponent retreats.
Kalista.watch: Kalista E Rend deals heavy damage after spears have built up in you, so if several spears are lodged, stop fighting and fall back until they disappear. Kalista R Fate's Call can pull in and throw her support, so spread out if the support stays close to Kalista. Armor cannot block the maximum-health-based magic damage from Kalista W Sentinel.

KogMaw.build: Build magic resistance first against Kog’Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog’Maw E Void Ooze. You also need armor against his physical basic attack damage, but avoid responding by stacking only health because of Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
KogMaw.combo: Set up caster minion health and calculate your position and target so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade kills minions in succession and bounces to Kog’Maw last. Follow with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. If Kog’Maw is caught by Jhin E Captive Audience, confirm the mark and root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish, then follow with basic attacks. Finish him with Jhin R Curtain Call as he retreats while injured.
KogMaw.escape: Kog’Maw has no mobility ability, so you don’t need to wait for him to use an ability to create distance. Close in after Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you dodge the slow from Kog’Maw E Void Ooze. If Kog’Maw Q Caustic Spittle hits you, don’t stay close while your armor and magic resistance are reduced.
KogMaw.fight: Trade briefly after Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends. Kog’Maw has no mobility ability, so hold him with the slow from Jhin E Captive Audience, and if the trap marks him, root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish and hit him with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot.
KogMaw.laning: Farm safely while threatening with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot loaded. When Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage activates, back off, then pressure him after it ends. After firing your final shot, move out of the opponent’s range and use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and other abilities to cover the reload.
KogMaw.phase: Early on, survive safely while watching Jhin’s reload window, and pressure Kog’Maw when Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is down. In the mid game, use Jhin R Curtain Call to join fights outside the lane and take objectives and turrets to slow Kog’Maw’s growth. Kog’Maw gets stronger as the late game approaches, so look for chances to finish him first with help from your allies.
KogMaw.teamfight: Fight behind your allied frontline and use Jhin E Captive Audience to block approach paths. Immediately after an allied immobilizing effect hits Kog’Maw, root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. If he retreats while injured, open Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position. Immediately after killing Kog’Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid Kog’Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.watch: While Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, he has increased range and each basic attack deals damage based on your maximum health, so keep your distance and wait for it to end. If hit by Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, your armor and magic resistance are reduced, so stand behind minions or dodge to the side. When low on health, watch out for Kog'Maw R Living Artillery and move out of vision. After taking down Kog'Maw, walk backward to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Lucian.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game to withstand Lucian's primarily physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and build armor first.
Lucian.combo: Set up the caster minions' health so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade kills minions in succession and bounces to Lucian last. Follow with Jhin P Whisper's final shot on Lucian. If Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, create an opening to catch him first with Jhin E Captive Audience or an ally's immobilizing crowd control, then root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish and finish with basic attacks and, if needed, Jhin R Curtain Call.
Lucian.escape: The moment after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is your chance to close the gap and catch him. Slow and mark him with Jhin E Captive Audience, then land Jhin W Deadly Flourish so he can't escape.
Lucian.fight: Let Lucian's first combo pass, then retaliate after his abilities are down. Right after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, slow and mark him with Jhin E Captive Audience, then look to root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Use Jhin P Whisper's final shot on Lucian instead of a minion, then back off while reloading and fill the gap with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade or other abilities.
Lucian.laning: Early on, farm safely while keeping Jhin P Whisper's final shot loaded as a threat. Avoid the line behind minions Lucian hits with Lucian Q Piercing Light, and after firing your final shot, move out of his range to reload. Keep one Jhin E Captive Audience trap in reserve and use the others to cover approaches through brush and the river.
Lucian.phase: Early on, Lucian's explosive first combo is dangerous, so survive safely while using the threat of Jhin's final shot. Once you've built items, pick off squishy targets with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and your final shot, but avoid extended fights against high-health opponents.
Lucian.teamfight: Jhin should use his range from the backline and block Lucian's approach in advance with Jhin E Captive Audience. Follow up with Jhin W Deadly Flourish immediately after an ally applies immobilizing crowd control, and use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position when an injured opponent retreats. If Lucian R The Culling hits you, dodge to the side instead of moving straight backward.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches farther than its indicator suggests, so don't stand in a straight line behind a minion Lucian is hitting. Lucian R The Culling cannot change direction while being cast, so dodge to the side instead of running straight backward. Avoid trading when Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to close in and start his first combo; also back off when his next two shots are empowered by an ally's shield or heal, or by an ally's immobilizing crowd control.

MissFortune.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Miss Fortune's main damage is physical and Jhin has low armor, so build armor first. Armor does not block the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.combo: Set up the caster minions' health so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade kills minions in succession and bounces to Miss Fortune last. Follow with Jhin P Whisper's final shot. Once Miss Fortune steps on Jhin E Captive Audience and is marked, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish, add basic attacks, and finish with Jhin R Curtain Call if needed.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no movement ability that creates distance, so leave the area of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and dodge the cone of Miss Fortune R Bullet Time before closing the gap. Mark her with Jhin E Captive Audience or an ally's attack, then land Jhin W Deadly Flourish to root her.
MissFortune.fight: Use minions to bounce Jhin Q Dancing Grenade off minions you kill onto Miss Fortune, then add Jhin P Whisper's final shot for a short trade. If Miss Fortune uses Miss Fortune W Strut to run away, hit her with long-range damage such as Jhin W Deadly Flourish to reset her movement speed and chase. Don't continue trading basic attacks while Jhin is reloading; use abilities and manage your distance.
MissFortune.laning: Avoid standing directly behind a minion to avoid Miss Fortune Q Double Up. After Miss Fortune gets a minion last hit, create distance so you don't get hit by her empowered next basic attack. Use Jhin P Whisper's final shot to pressure Miss Fortune, then back off after firing and farm with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade or other abilities while reloading.
MissFortune.phase: Early on, avoid Miss Fortune's harass through minions, and farm safely while keeping the threat of Jhin's final shot. In the mid game, use Jhin R Curtain Call to target an injured Miss Fortune's escape route; once you've built items, look for chances to pick her off with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and your final shot. The available information isn't enough to say which side is stronger late game, so avoid the angle of Miss Fortune R Bullet Time in teamfights and target squishy opponents.
MissFortune.teamfight: Jhin should use his range from the backline and land Jhin W Deadly Flourish on Miss Fortune after an ally applies immobilizing crowd control. Don't start a fight where Miss Fortune E Make It Rain has landed; move out of its area. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time begins, dodge to the side of its cone, and use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position when an injured Miss Fortune retreats.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces off minions, so don't stand in a straight line with a minion. If Miss Fortune E Make It Rain lands, you can be slowed in its area and hit by Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, so move out of it. Miss Fortune R Bullet Time locks its direction when cast, so dodge to the side of its cone instead of only backing away.

Nilah.build: Nilah’s main damage is physical, and Jhin has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to hold out, then buy Plated Steelcaps. Nilah Q Formless Blade has armor penetration, so build health along with armor. If Nilah’s healing prevents you from finishing her, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Nilah.combo: Set up the caster minions’ health so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade kills them in succession and bounces to Nilah last. If Nilah W Jubilant Veil has ended, follow up with Jhin P Whisper’s fourth shot. When Nilah engages, use Jhin E Captive Audience to slow and mark her, then root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish and land a basic attack. If Nilah’s health is low and she retreats, finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position.
Nilah.escape: Your opportunity to attack comes after Nilah has used both Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil. However, Nilah E Slipstream can be used again, so mark her with Jhin E Captive Audience or a basic attack, root her first with Jhin W Deadly Flourish, then attack. If Nilah R Apotheosis is available, don’t start Jhin R Curtain Call within her pull range.
Nilah.fight: Before Nilah approaches, pressure her from a range where Jhin P Whisper’s fourth shot can hit a champion. While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade or Jhin E Captive Audience instead of basic attacks, then look for the fourth shot after the effect ends. Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so rather than waiting for her dash to be down, mark her first and root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish.
Nilah.laning: Immediately after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, move beyond her increased range. After firing Jhin’s fourth shot, get out of the enemy’s range while reloading. During the reload, use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and Jhin E Captive Audience to cover the opening.
Nilah.phase: Early on, use Jhin’s range to pressure Nilah as she goes for last hits, but back off to reload after firing the fourth shot. In late-game team fights, watch for Nilah’s engage and healing, and have Jhin fight from behind his allies.
Nilah.teamfight: Place Jhin E Captive Audience in Nilah’s likely path before she engages, and keep your distance behind your allied frontline. If Nilah engages with Nilah E Slipstream and uses up Nilah W Jubilant Veil, hit her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish when a trap or an ally’s attack marks her. Spread out so Nilah R Apotheosis doesn’t pull multiple allies; if you’ve already been pulled in, attack Nilah immediately.
Nilah.watch: After Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range and area increase, so take another step back. When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, Jhin’s basic attacks miss, so hold them and respond with abilities or wait for the effect to end. Spread out so multiple allies aren’t caught together by Nilah R Apotheosis’s pull.

Samira.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Samira's main damage is physical and Jhin has low armor, so build armor first.
Samira.combo: Set up the caster minions' health, then use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill minions in succession so the final bounce hits Samira, and add Jhin P Whisper's final shot. Make this attack after Samira W Blade Whirl ends. If Samira is marked after stepping on Jhin E Captive Audience or being hit by an ally's attack, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish, then finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call when she retreats injured.
Samira.escape: If Samira has used Samira E Wild Rush and no one has died, that's your chance to catch her while her mobility is down. If she steps on Jhin E Captive Audience and is marked, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish so she can't escape.
Samira.fight: Keep your distance and harass so Samira can't get into melee range. Attack after Samira W Blade Whirl ends or after she uses Samira E Wild Rush. Use Jhin P Whisper's final shot on a champion, and when reloading, back off and fill the gap with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and Jhin E Captive Audience.
Samira.laning: Manage the path Samira uses to approach, and farm safely while keeping the threat of a loaded final shot. Save one Jhin E Captive Audience trap for escape and follow-up, and place another in brush or by the river to watch her approach. After firing your final shot, move out of Samira's range to reload.
Samira.teamfight: Use your range from the backline and root Samira with Jhin W Deadly Flourish immediately after an ally applies immobilizing crowd control. If Samira R Inferno Trigger starts while she is marked, interrupt it with Jhin W Deadly Flourish's root. Block her approach in advance with Jhin E Captive Audience, and retreat together so no low-health ally is left behind.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is active, it destroys projectiles and basic attacks, so attack after it ends. Avoid Samira's engage angles, since Samira P Daredevil Impulse can follow when she closes in with Samira E Wild Rush or when an enemy support's crowd control hits you. Samira R Inferno Trigger deals continuous damage and heals her, so if she is marked, interrupt it with Jhin W Deadly Flourish's root.

Senna.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Senna's main damage is physical and Jhin has low armor, so build armor first. If healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness makes it hard to finish a target, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Senna.combo: Slow and mark Senna with a Jhin E Captive Audience trap, then root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Follow up with basic attacks and Jhin P Whisper's final shot; if Senna retreats after losing health, finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position. In lane, set up Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill minions in succession and hit Senna with the final bounce, then add your final shot.
Senna.escape: The moment after Senna W Last Embrace misses or is blocked by a minion is your chance to close the gap. If Senna approaches with Senna E Curse of the Black Mist active, don't fight there; retreat to an area with vision or place Jhin E Captive Audience in the mist to block her approach.
Senna.fight: Harass Senna when she steps forward to collect a soul, and look for a chance to close the gap after Senna W Last Embrace misses. Set up Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to bounce to Senna after killing a minion and getting empowered, then use Jhin P Whisper's final shot on her. After firing, use the movement speed to back off and reload.
Senna.laning: Track Senna's soul locations early and harass near them to disrupt her collection. Move out of the line of Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and stand behind minions so you can dodge Senna W Last Embrace. Farm while keeping the threat of Jhin P Whisper's loaded final shot, and during reloads, move out of her range and fill the gap with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade.
Senna.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so pressure her when she steps forward to collect a soul, while managing Jhin's reloads and farming safely. In the mid game, look for chances to pick off a low-health Senna with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and Jhin P Whisper's final shot. If Senna collects souls into the late game, her range and attack damage will increase, so disrupting her collection from the start is important.
Senna.teamfight: Jhin should position behind his frontline where Senna W Last Embrace can't root him, then use Jhin W Deadly Flourish immediately after an ally's immobilizing effect or Jhin E Captive Audience hits. Target Senna with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position when she retreats after losing health.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through minions or allies, slowing and healing, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions; if it hits you, move away from allies before the root spreads. After Senna hits you once, back off to avoid a second hit and prevent her from collecting mist.

Seraphine.build: Seraphine's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance instead of armor. If healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound makes it hard to finish a target, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Seraphine.combo: Hit Seraphine with Jhin W Deadly Flourish after she steps on Jhin E Captive Audience and root her, then follow up with a basic attack and your final shot. Jhin W Deadly Flourish requires a mark from Jhin's basic attack or trap, or an ally's attack. If Seraphine retreats injured, finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position.
Seraphine.escape: The moment after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down is your chance to close the gap. Seraphine has no mobility ability, so mark her with a basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience and catch her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. If you've been slowed, don't engage; move out of the line of Seraphine E Beat Drop.
Seraphine.fight: After dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop, trade when Seraphine is alone and away from her allies. Kill minions to empower Jhin Q Dancing Grenade, aim its final bounce at Seraphine, and add Jhin P Whisper's final shot.
Seraphine.laning: Early on, farm safely while keeping Jhin P Whisper's final shot loaded as a threat. After firing your final shot, move away instead of staying within Seraphine's range, and use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade or other abilities while reloading. Keep one Jhin E Captive Audience trap in reserve and use the others to watch approaches through brush and the river.
Seraphine.phase: Early on, Jhin is easy to catch while reloading, so play safely and trade only when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. In the mid game, Jhin R Curtain Call and his final shot can create chances to pick off an injured Seraphine, but account for healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound. There isn't enough evidence to say either side is always stronger late game, so avoid Seraphine's crowd control and target squishy opponents.
Seraphine.teamfight: Jhin should use his range from the backline and follow up with Jhin W Deadly Flourish immediately after an ally applies immobilizing crowd control. Stand spread out to either side of your allies so Seraphine R Encore can't hit them in succession. Block her approach with Jhin E Captive Audience, and use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position when an injured Seraphine retreats.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you are slowed, immediately move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so don't stand in a line with your allies.

Sivir.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sivir's main damage is physical and Jhin has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If healing from Sivir E Spell Shield makes it hard to finish a target, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Sivir.combo: Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first. Once the shield is down, mark her with Jhin E Captive Audience or a basic attack, then root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish and follow up with a basic attack and Jhin P Whisper's final shot. If Sivir retreats after losing health, finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position.
Sivir.escape: Sivir has no blink movement ability or skill that creates distance on its own, so her Sivir E Spell Shield being down is your chance to catch her. Avoid chasing while Sivir R On The Hunt is active, and look to land Jhin W Deadly Flourish on Sivir after she is marked once it ends.
Sivir.fight: Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then mark her with Jhin E Captive Audience or a basic attack and root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. In trades, kill minions to empower Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and bounce its final hit to Sivir, then add Jhin P Whisper's final shot. After firing your final shot, back off to reload.
Sivir.laning: Farm safely while using the threat of Jhin P Whisper's loaded final shot. During reloads, don't stay within the enemy's range; fill the gap with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade, Jhin W Deadly Flourish, and Jhin E Captive Audience. Sivir clears waves quickly, so push first or make sure an ally is ready to catch the wave before leaving lane.
Sivir.phase: Early on, Jhin should survive and farm with the threat of his final shot instead of forcing damage. Once you've built items, target low-health squishy opponents, but avoid chasing while Sivir R On The Hunt is active.
Sivir.teamfight: Block approach paths with Jhin E Captive Audience and fight from behind your allies. Once Sivir E Spell Shield is down and an ally applies immobilizing crowd control, follow up with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position when an injured Sivir retreats.
Sivir.watch: Watch the path of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and dodge so it hits you neither on its way out nor on its return. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one of Jhin's abilities and heals Sivir, so bait it out before attempting a root. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, the entire enemy team moves faster, so avoid long chases.

Smolder.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first to account for Smolder's main damage, but manage your health with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath's true damage and execute threshold in mind. If healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! makes it hard to finish a target, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Smolder.combo: Set up the caster minions' health, then use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill minions in succession so the final bounce hits Smolder, and add Jhin P Whisper's final shot. If Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, mark him with Jhin E Captive Audience or a basic attack, then root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Finish Smolder with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position when he retreats after losing health.
Smolder.fight: The moment after Smolder uses Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is your chance to close the gap. Mark him with a Jhin basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, then root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Don't follow him into the flames of Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!.
Smolder.laning: Pressure Smolder's farming from the start so he can't stack by hitting champions with abilities or killing enemies with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Don't use Jhin P Whisper's final shot on a minion; use its threat to make Smolder back off. After firing it, back off and farm with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade or other abilities while reloading.
Smolder.phase: Early on, Smolder is weakest before he has stacks, so pressure his farming while Jhin keeps a safe distance during reloads. In the mid game, use Jhin's burst and Jhin R Curtain Call to pick off a squishy Smolder and quickly secure objectives and towers. The longer the game goes, the more Smolder benefits from stacking permanently.
Smolder.teamfight: Block approach paths with Jhin E Captive Audience and fight from the backline. Root Smolder with Jhin W Deadly Flourish after an ally applies immobilizing crowd control or once Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down. Use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position when Smolder retreats after losing health.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! explodes and slows when it hits a champion, and also grants stacking progress. Dodge by standing behind minions or moving to the side. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so move out of the flames, then fight again.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only escape over terrain, so engage right after he uses it. Jhin W Deadly Flourish only roots a marked target, so hit him first with a Jhin basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience. If Smolder W Achooo! has slowed you, prioritize dodging, since you're vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

Tristana.combo: Set up the mage minions’ health, then use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill them in succession so the final bounce hits Tristana. Follow with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot on her. If Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, mark her with Jhin E Captive Audience or a basic attack, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish, and finish with Jhin R Curtain Call if needed.
Tristana.escape: Engage right after Tristana uses Tristana W Rocket Jump. Mark her with a basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, then hit her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish to root her. If Tristana R Buster Shot is still available, account for that crowd control and delay your engage.
Tristana.fight: After making Tristana use Tristana W Rocket Jump, look for a chance to close the gap. Mark her with a Jhin basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, then root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. When trading, angle Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill and bounce through minions so the final bounce hits Tristana, then add Jhin P Whisper’s final shot.
Tristana.laning: Early on, threaten with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot loaded and farm safely. Stand apart from allied minions so Tristana E Explosive Charge’s splash damage doesn’t reach you when she kills a minion. After firing the final shot, back off and finish reloading while farming with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade or other abilities.
Tristana.phase: Tristana is weak early and has long ability cooldowns, but Jhin is also weak while reloading, so play safely. In mid game, once Jhin has items and Jhin R Curtain Call, he can pick off wounded enemies from long range. Tristana is difficult to handle with a completed build, so aim to pressure the lane and turrets and end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: Stay behind your team and use Jhin E Captive Audience to block Tristana’s approach, then hit Jhin W Deadly Flourish after an ally applies immobilizing crowd control. When a wounded Tristana retreats, use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position. If an ally dies and resets Tristana W Rocket Jump, retreat immediately so you aren’t picked off in a chain.
Tristana.watch: To avoid the splash damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge, don’t stand close to allied minions. Don’t engage recklessly while both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are ready. Tristana R Buster Shot’s stun or knockback can interrupt Jhin R Curtain Call, so use it from a safe position.

TwistedFate.build: Twisted Fate’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. Consider movement speed so you can leave the marked attack areas in time.
TwistedFate.combo: Hit Twisted Fate with Jhin W Deadly Flourish after he steps on Jhin E Captive Audience to root him, then follow with a basic attack. Focus damage with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot, and finish a target retreating after losing health with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position. To root with Jhin W Deadly Flourish, first mark the target with Jhin’s basic attack, a trap, or an allied attack.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate spends the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is a chance to approach.
TwistedFate.fight: Try to trade while Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is on a Blue or Red Card. Line up Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill minions in succession and send the final bounce to Twisted Fate, then add Jhin P Whisper’s final shot.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, pressure with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot loaded and farm safely. After firing the final shot, back off; during the reload, use abilities such as Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to cover the gap. Place Jhin E Captive Audience in the river and brush to provide vision and slow approach routes.
TwistedFate.phase: Jhin is weak while reloading early, so pressure with the final shot but play safely. Once you have items, target the low-armor Twisted Fate with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and Jhin P Whisper’s final shot.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Stay far behind your team and hit Jhin W Deadly Flourish as soon as an ally applies immobilizing crowd control, then use Jhin R Curtain Call when a wounded enemy retreats. Watch for the Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and block approach routes with Jhin E Captive Audience. If you can predict where Twisted Fate R Destiny will land, secure vision there in advance; when you can interrupt his movement, hit a marked target with Jhin W Deadly Flourish.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a Gold Card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, his next basic attack stuns, so stay outside his attack range. Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards can hit multiple targets, so reduce the damage by standing behind minions.

Twitch.build: Get a Control Ward early to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush. Armor helps against Twitch’s main damage from basic attacks, but one type of resistance can’t block both damage types from Twitch E Contaminate. Get health to withstand the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom, and consider options that reduce attack speed.
Twitch.combo: Hit Twitch with Jhin W Deadly Flourish after he steps on Jhin E Captive Audience to root him, then follow with a basic attack. Deal heavy damage with the final shot, and finish a wounded Twitch retreating with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position. In lane, set up minion health and use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill them in succession so the final bounce hits Twitch, then add the final shot.
Twitch.escape: Look for a chance to attack after Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals his position, and Twitch W Venom Cask is down. Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so you can hold him in place by slowing and marking him with Jhin E Captive Audience, then hitting him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish.
Twitch.fight: Don’t trade with Twitch while Jhin is reloading. Deal brief damage and back off when Jhin P Whisper’s final shot is loaded. If Twitch becomes visible after Twitch Q Ambush ends or takes position with Twitch R Spray and Pray active, focus him with your team. Slow and mark him with Jhin E Captive Audience, then hit Jhin W Deadly Flourish to hold him for your attacks.
Twitch.laning: Check brush without vision and narrow paths with a Control Ward or Jhin E Captive Audience before passing through. If Twitch disappears from lane, he may roam to another lane, so alert your allies. After using the final shot, back off and reload; use abilities such as Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to farm during that time.
Twitch.phase: Jhin is weak while reloading early, so farm safely by threatening with the final shot instead of fighting Twitch for too long. In mid game, make use of the burst from Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and the final shot, and target a wounded Twitch’s escape route with Jhin R Curtain Call. Late game, watch for the piercing attacks from Twitch R Spray and Pray; stay behind your team and pick Twitch off when allies apply crowd control.
Twitch.teamfight: Spread out sideways from the direction Twitch R Spray and Pray is firing, and position beyond its increased range. Block approach routes with Jhin E Captive Audience, and use Jhin W Deadly Flourish when Twitch loses stealth or takes position, timed with your allies’ crowd control. Cast Jhin R Curtain Call from safely behind to target a Twitch who has lost health.
Twitch.watch: Watch for trades where Twitch uses Twitch Q Ambush to approach, stacks basic attacks, then finishes with Twitch E Contaminate. Even if you still have health, back off after taking several basic attacks. Leave immediately if Twitch W Venom Cask lands beneath you. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, account for its increased range, keep your distance, and don’t stand in a line with allies.

Varus.build: Get Cloth Armor early to help you survive, then choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Varus mainly deals physical damage, so build armor first, but remember that armor won’t block Varus W Blighted Quiver or Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Varus.combo: Slow Varus and mark him with Jhin E Captive Audience, then root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Follow with a basic attack and use Jhin P Whisper’s final shot on him. Finish a Varus retreating after losing health with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position.
Varus.escape: Look for a chance to close the gap after dodging Varus R Chain of Corruption or after Varus uses it. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so you can hold him in place by marking him with Jhin E Captive Audience and hitting him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish.
Varus.fight: While Varus is aiming Varus Q Piercing Arrow, dodge to the side and look for a chance to close the gap. Account for minion positions so the final bounce of Jhin Q Dancing Grenade hits Varus, then use Jhin P Whisper’s final shot on him. After the final shot, back off to reload and cover the gap with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade or Jhin E Captive Audience.
Varus.laning: Early on, keep Jhin P Whisper’s final shot loaded to maintain pressure while farming safely. If Varus’s basic attacks have applied Blight stacks, don’t stay within his ability range; back off. Keep one Jhin E Captive Audience charge in reserve and use the others to watch the brush and river for gank routes.
Varus.phase: Early on, play safely and keep the threat of your final shot instead of overcommitting to deal damage. From mid game onward, as you gain items, Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and the final shot give you more chances to pick off low-armor targets like Varus. The late-game matchup can’t be determined from the available information alone; Jhin should target squishy enemies rather than tanky ones.
Varus.teamfight: Stay far behind your team and hit Varus with Jhin W Deadly Flourish after an ally applies immobilizing crowd control. If he retreats while wounded, use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position. If Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, spread out so the tendrils don’t spread. Avoid engaging for the few seconds after Varus gets stronger from a kill or assist.
Varus.watch: If Varus hits you with an ability while stacks of Varus W Blighted Quiver are applied, it triggers bonus damage based on your max health. If you’ve taken several basic attacks, back off and wait for the stacks to expire. When you see Varus aiming Varus Q Piercing Arrow, sidestep its path. If an ally is bound by Varus R Chain of Corruption, keep your distance so the tendrils don’t reach you.

Vayne.build: Get Cloth Armor early to help you survive, then choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first to deal with the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. Armor won’t reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, which scales with max health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Vayne.combo: Set up the caster minions’ health and your position so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade kills them in succession and bounces to Vayne last. Follow with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot on Vayne. After Vayne Q Tumble is down, slow and mark her with Jhin E Captive Audience, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish, and follow with a basic attack. If a wounded Vayne retreats, finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position.
Vayne.escape: Close the gap right after Vayne Q Tumble is down and hold her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. While Vayne E Condemn is available, avoid engaging with a wall behind you.
Vayne.fight: The moment after Vayne uses Vayne Q Tumble is a chance to engage. First mark her with Jhin’s basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, then root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish and hit her with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. After the final shot, back off to reload and cover the gap with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and Jhin E Captive Audience.
Vayne.laning: When Vayne’s health and armor are low early, push the lane from a safe position to disrupt her farming. Don’t fight with a wall behind you; stand inside the minion wave or toward the open river. Place Jhin E Captive Audience in the brush and river to watch approach routes. Don’t stay within Vayne’s range while reloading.
Vayne.phase: Vayne is weak early, so safely push the lane to take away time she could spend farming. In mid game, use the burst from Jhin’s grenade and final shot, along with the long-range follow-up of Jhin R Curtain Call, to target a squishy Vayne. Vayne is difficult to stop once she has items late, so convert your early and mid-game advantage into objectives and turrets.
Vayne.teamfight: Block Vayne’s approach with Jhin E Captive Audience and fight from far behind your team. Position in an open area rather than a narrow passage so Vayne can’t line up a wall stun. Hit Jhin W Deadly Flourish as soon as an ally applies immobilizing crowd control, then use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position when a wounded Vayne retreats.
Vayne.watch: Avoid fighting with a wall behind you, since being knocked into one by Vayne E Condemn will stun you and put you in danger. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on your max health after hitting the same target several times, so count the hits and move out of range just before it triggers.

Xayah.build: Buy Cloth Armor first, then choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Xayah’s main damage is physical, and Jhin has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Xayah.combo: Set up the mage minions’ health, then use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill them in succession so the final bounce hits Xayah, and fire Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. If Xayah R Featherstorm is down, mark her with Jhin E Captive Audience or an allied attack, then root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Follow with basic attacks and, if needed, finish a retreating Xayah with Jhin R Curtain Call.
Xayah.escape: To dodge the root from Xayah E Bladecaller, sidestep out of the feather recall path, then line up Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Before using Jhin W Deadly Flourish to root her, mark her with a basic attack, Jhin E Captive Audience, or an allied attack.
Xayah.fight: Keep trades short and reposition, since feathers build up if you fight Xayah for too long. Send the final bounce of Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to Xayah, then add Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. After Xayah R Featherstorm is down, mark her with Jhin E Captive Audience or an allied attack and look to root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish.
Xayah.laning: Threaten with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot loaded and farm safely. After using it, move out of Xayah’s range and use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade or other abilities to cover the reload. Keep one Jhin E Captive Audience charge in reserve and place the others in the brush and river to watch for gank routes.
Xayah.teamfight: Use Jhin’s range from far behind your team, and block approach routes in advance with Jhin E Captive Audience. Don’t rush Jhin W Deadly Flourish while Xayah R Featherstorm is available; after her ultimate is down, root her when she is marked and an ally applies immobilizing crowd control. Use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position to target a wounded Xayah as she retreats.
Xayah.watch: When feathers build up from Xayah P Clean Cuts and Xayah Q Double Daggers, watch the recall path of Xayah E Bladecaller. If three or more feathers lie along a line between Jhin and Xayah, you can be rooted, so sidestep out of the line instead of retreating straight back.
Xayah.phase: In the early game, Jhin should play safely with the threat of his final shot rather than overextending to build up damage.

Yasuo.build: Hold out early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Yasuo’s main damage, including Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath, is physical, so build armor first.
Yasuo.combo: First break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield. Set up the caster minions’ health, then use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade so it kills minions in succession and its final bounce hits Yasuo. Follow up with Jhin P Whisper’s fourth shot. If Jhin E Captive Audience catches Yasuo, confirm the mark, then root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. If needed, finish him with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest launches its tornado is your chance to engage. However, Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t chase just because that ability is down. Before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again, time your engage with your allies’ crowd control and root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish.
Yasuo.fight: First break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then commit to a full trade. Right after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado is launched, his knock-up stacks reset, so keep your distance and trade briefly with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and the fourth shot.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin and toward your side of the lane to reduce the number of minions Yasuo can use to dash in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Look for a chance to use Jhin P Whisper’s fourth shot on Yasuo, but retreat after firing and farm with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade or other abilities while reloading. Keep one Jhin E Captive Audience in reserve to stop an approach, and place any extras in the bushes and river.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, Jhin is at a disadvantage when Yasuo can reach him through the wave, so manage your distance and reloads to hold out. In the mid game, as Jhin builds items, Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and the fourth shot become more explosive, so look for short trades and picks. There’s no information to confirm a relative advantage in the late game, so Jhin should keep choosing vulnerable targets from a safe distance.
Yasuo.teamfight: Use Jhin E Captive Audience to block Yasuo’s engage path in advance, and stand behind your allied frontline. Root an enemy with Jhin W Deadly Flourish immediately after an ally’s immobilizing effect lands, then use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position on an opponent who is retreating after taking damage. Against Yasuo W Wind Wall, change your projectile angle or hold key abilities until the wall disappears.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones to reach Jhin, and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you airborne with a tornado after hitting twice, making it dangerous. When his tornado stacks are full, move out of its line and dodge to the side. If Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, change your projectile angle or hold your shots until the wall disappears.

Zeri.build: Get Cloth Armor early to help you survive, then choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser mainly deal physical damage, so build armor first. Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on max health, so be cautious about relying on a large health stack alone.
Zeri.combo: Set up the mage minions’ health, then angle Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill them in succession and bounce to Zeri last. Add Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. After Zeri E Spark Surge is down, slow and mark her with Jhin E Captive Audience, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish, and follow with a basic attack. If a wounded Zeri retreats, finish her with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe distance.
Zeri.escape: Engage right after Zeri uses Zeri E Spark Surge, in open terrain away from walls. To root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish, first mark her with Jhin’s basic attack, Jhin E Captive Audience, or an allied attack. Don’t chase on foot after Zeri R Lightning Crash is active.
Zeri.fight: The moment after Zeri uses Zeri E Spark Surge is a chance to engage. Mark her with Jhin E Captive Audience or a basic attack, then root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Hit her with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot once she has lost a lot of health. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, look for a chance to hold her with immobilizing effects instead of chasing.
Zeri.laning: Use Zeri’s short basic attack range to look for a lead in trades and CS before she gets her core items. Pressure with Jhin P Whisper’s final shot loaded, but back off to reload after firing. Farm with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade during the reload, and place Jhin E Captive Audience in the brush and river to watch approach routes.
Zeri.phase: Early on, Jhin has a chance to build a lead by taking advantage of Zeri’s short range and low kill pressure. In mid game, use Jhin R Curtain Call to join fights outside your lane, and once you have items, target a squishy Zeri with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and the final shot. After Zeri gets her core items, her mobility makes her difficult to pick off, so in late game attack in time with your allies’ immobilizing effects.
Zeri.teamfight: Use Jhin’s range from far behind your team, and place Jhin E Captive Audience in Zeri’s approach routes in advance. When an ally holds Zeri in place or a trap marks her, root her with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Don’t chase while Zeri R Lightning Crash is active; when a wounded Zeri retreats, use Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall or face her head-on in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing a wall, so don’t push her toward one. When Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, her movement speed increases, so don’t chase her on foot. When low on health, watch out for the execute from Zeri P Living Battery.

Ziggs.build: Get movement speed first to make it easier to leave the marked attack areas and avoid Ziggs’s damage. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance over armor. The provided information doesn’t specify a purchase order for particular items.
Ziggs.combo: Slow and mark Ziggs with Jhin E Captive Audience, then root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Follow with a basic attack and use Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. If a wounded Ziggs retreats, finish him with Jhin R Curtain Call from a safe position. Jhin W Deadly Flourish won’t root him if you hit him before he is marked.
Ziggs.fight: Close the gap right after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down. Use Jhin Q Dancing Grenade to kill minions in succession and send the final bounce to Ziggs, then add Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. After the final shot, back off during the reload and use abilities to cover the gap.
Ziggs.laning: Early on, keep Jhin P Whisper’s final shot loaded to make Ziggs back off while you farm safely. Don’t stay within Ziggs’s range while reloading; clear minions with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade. If Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear the wave, look for your next trade.
Ziggs.phase: Jhin is weak while reloading early, so farm safely and look for trades only when Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down. In mid game, use Jhin R Curtain Call to join fights outside your lane, and once you have items, you can pick off Ziggs with Jhin Q Dancing Grenade and Jhin P Whisper’s final shot. The available information can’t determine who has the advantage late, so avoid Ziggs’s area attacks in team fights and fight from behind your allies.
Ziggs.teamfight: Block approach routes in advance with Jhin E Captive Audience and fight from behind your allies. When an ally applies immobilizing crowd control to Ziggs, root him with Jhin W Deadly Flourish, then target a wounded Ziggs retreating with Jhin R Curtain Call. Don’t clump together in front of an objective where Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb can hit everyone.
Ziggs.watch: If you step on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, the slow makes it easy to get hit by follow-up abilities, so detour around the affected area or wait for the mines to disappear. When the area of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move away from the center of the explosion even if you can’t dodge it completely.
Ziggs.escape: Right after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down is an opportunity to close the distance. Don’t enter a path covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield; find another route. If Ziggs can cross a wall from his position, check vision and the route on the other side of the wall before engaging.
